name.ja: 30MM オプションパーツセット ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON WEAPON SET 01
name.en: 30MM OPTION PARTS SET ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON WEAPON SET 01

ja: 『ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON』のアイテムが30 MINUTES MISSIONSシリーズで商品化。
シリーズのキーコンセプト「シンプル組立」「カスタム遊び」のもと、人気のレーザーライフルを含めた武器群がオプションパーツセットで登場。
• 左右装備時に形状が変わる武装は、右再現用・左再現用のパーツがそれぞれ付属し、選択式で組み立て可能。
• 「VP-67LD」にはクリア成形のエフェクトパーツが付属し、展開状態を再現可能。
en: "ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON" items are commercialized in the 30 MINUTES MISSIONS series.
Based on the series' key concepts of "simple assembly " and " custom play," a group of weapons including the popular laser rifle are now available as optional parts sets.
• Weapons that change shape when equipped on the left and right come with parts for right and left reproduction, and can be assembled selectively.
• "VP-67LD" comes with clear molded effect parts, allowing you to reproduce the unfolded state.
